title: Iron Legion terrain zone type
description: A terrain zone type (content/zones/*.json5) referenced by map zone polygons (Simulation Spec SIM-MOVE-031). Mods may add zone types.

move_mult.description: Soldier speed multiplier inside the zone (SIM-MOVE-020).

move_cost.description: Pathfinding cost multiplier per nav cell; at least 1 so the A* heuristic stays admissible (SIM-MOVE-001).

conceal.description: Regiments inside are hidden beyond visibility.conceal_radius (Phase 2).

formation_integrity_mult.description: Integrity multiplier applied inside the zone (SIM-FORM-031).

passable.description: False makes every nav cell touching the zone impassable (rock, water outside crossings).

colour.description: Terrain tint used by the renderer until zone textures exist.
